bias.headline: Conditions tilt narrowly bullish (led by Volatility), but the picture is close to balanced — Market Breadth reads the other way.

topBullish.label: Volatility
topBullish.confidenceBasis: 499 prior sessions of this instrument's own ATR history. Confidence is halved deliberately: the volatility-return relationship is a conditional regularity, not a mechanism.
topBullish.explanation: SPY typically moves 0.81% in a day right now — more volatile than 9% of its own past. That is calm, and calm is the condition most steady advances happen in.
topBullish.whyItMatters: Position size and stop distance both scale with volatility, so the same trade is a different risk in a different regime. In equities specifically, expanding volatility tends to accompany falling prices.
topBullish.nextTrigger: stops being bearish if it climbs out of the bottom third of its own past readings — right now it is higher than only 9% of them

topBearish.label: Market Breadth
topBearish.confidenceBasis: 95 individual companies, each counted once, against 500 sessions of this panel's own breadth history. A participation count rather than an index proxy — but still a large-cap panel, not a full advance/decline line, so confidence is capped at 75.
topBearish.explanation: 47% of 95 companies are trading above their own 50-session average. That is unusually narrow — higher than only 22% of its own past readings for this group, whose typical session reads 61%.
topBearish.whyItMatters: A rally carried by one or two names is fragile in a way the index level does not show. Broad participation is what separates a durable advance from a narrow one.
topBearish.nextTrigger: stops being bearish if it climbs out of the bottom third of its own past readings — right now it is higher than only 22% of them

topBearish.label: Market Structure
evidenceFor: Last swing high rejected; no reclaim above 777.88
topBearish.confidenceBasis: 8 swing highs and 10 swing lows over 120 sessions. Confidence scales with how decisively both legs moved relative to the 24% range, and is capped at 75 because a two-pivot sequence is short.
topBearish.explanation: SPY is printing lower highs and lower lows — an intact downtrend. Last swing high 771.10 vs prior 777.88; last swing low 761.78 vs prior 762.60.
topBearish.whyItMatters: Structure is the only read that describes the SHAPE of a move rather than its size. Two markets up the same amount are different trades if one is making higher lows and the other keeps undercutting them — and structure is what a stop is placed against.
topBearish.nextTrigger: breaks up above the last swing high of 771.10

metrics.label: Market Structure

metrics.whyItMatters: Structure is the only read that describes the SHAPE of a move rather than its size. Two markets up the same amount are different trades if one is making higher lows and the other keeps undercutting them — and structure is what a stop is placed against.
conflicts: Range is narrowing; structure resolves on the break, and gives no direction until it does.
metrics.nextTrigger: resolves on a close outside 527.75–535.24
